Avec passion et créativité, nous livrons des innovations alimentaires, des parfums inspirés de l'artisanat et développons des solutions de beauté et de bien-être. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre, avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde pour explorer des idées et des ambitions avec. Chaque jour, votre talent, votre esprit novateur et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir, faisant une différence positive sur des milliards de personnes. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine. Chef régional de la qualité F&B EAME En tant que responsable régional de Qualityfor Fragrance & Beauty (F&B) dans EAME, vous dirigerez la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de gestion de la qualité (QM) pour l'organisation Fragrance Operations dans la région EAME, y compris sa culture de la qualité et les comportements associés, les processus de contrôle, la normalisation des processus, les spécifications des produits et les validations de qualité afin de protéger et d'améliorer la qualité des produits. Championnez une mentalité centrée sur le client en veillant à ce que toutes les décisions, processus et résultats de qualité améliorent la confiance du client, la satisfaction et la réputation de la marque. Sous l'autorité de notre chef de la gestion mondiale de la qualité pour F&B, vous devrez concevoir et exécuter la stratégie - Fournir des renseignements clés sur la gestion de la qualité pour la définition de la stratégie opérationnelle et des objectifs connexes. - Exécuter la stratégie de gestion de la qualité en adaptant les plans tactiques et opérationnels connexes à la région désignée afin d'atteindre les objectifs spécifiques de la gestion de la qualité. Gestion de la fonction - Diriger la mise en oeuvre de procédures et de méthodes/protocoles pour maintenir la qualité des produits conformément à la politique établie, y compris l'équivalence standard de la marque, les normes de qualité (brut) des matériaux, les spécifications du produit fini et les exigences d'approbation du produit. - Fournir des services de mise à l'essai et de libération à l'appui des calendriers établis en étant la principale liaison technique avec les homologues des Opérations, des S-T et des Services commerciaux. - Mener des programmes d'évaluation dans les délais, les spécifications et les budgets approuvés. - Effectuer des audits/enquêtes pour mesurer le respect des exigences de qualité et corriger les écarts. - Préparer et examiner chaque fois que nécessaire les sections relatives à la qualité des dépôts réglementaires. - Représenter la perspective du contrôle de la qualité des opérations dans les projets critiques pour la région. - Restez à jour avec toutes les lois et tous les règlements de la région touchant les ingrédients et les produits pour s'assurer qu'ils sont conformes, doivent être reformulés ou doivent être retirés. - Exécuter le plan de fonctionnement annuel dans les limites du budget approuvé. Gestion des ressources humaines - Participer à l'exécution des processus annuels de gestion des ressources humaines au sein de l'organisation régionale de gestion des ressources humaines et valider les résultats connexes avec le gestionnaire opérationnel. - Collaborer avec l'équipe régionale de gestion des opérations et les partenaires opérationnels des RH à l'élaboration d'un bassin de talents pour l'organisation régionale de gestion de la qualité. - Favoriser le développement et la promotion des talents régionaux en QM au sein des Opérations. - Coach et mentors dans tous les aspects de leur rendement professionnel et de leur perfectionnement professionnel, y compris la formation, la rétroaction, les récompenses et d'autres mesures.
• Votre profil professionnel comprend les antécédents académiques - Bachelor Degee ou équivalent en chimie, biologie, sciences de l'environnement ou discipline connexe. -
• Qualifications liées à la gestion de la qualité préférées - Expérience professionnelle - Expérience professionnelle globale de 10 à 15 ans, y compris 5 à 8 ans de rôles de leadership progressifs. - Expérience éprouvée de la qualité ou des opérations fonction dans le parfum, la saveur, ou les biens de consommation. Compétences techniques - Expertise éprouvée dans la conception et l'exécution de stratégies de gestion de la qualité, en harmonisant les objectifs de qualité avec les objectifs opérationnels. - Des antécédents solides dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de systèmes, de procédures et de protocoles d'essai de qualité pour assurer la conformité et l'excellence des produits. - Expérience de la conduite de la conformité réglementaire, de la conduite des vérifications et de la gestion des enquêtes afin de respecter les normes applicables aux produits et aux processus. - Expérience en collaboration interfonctionnelle avec des équipes d'exploitation, de science et de technologie et commerciale pour soutenir le contrôle de la qualité et la libération des produits. - Une solide expérience en matière de documentation réglementaire et de conformité des produits sur les marchés régionaux. - Expérience dans la direction et le développement d'équipes, le mentorat et la planification de la relève au sein de fonctions de qualité. - Connaissance de la gestion budgétaire et de la planification opérationnelle des organisations régionales de qualité. L'emplacement principal de ce rôle est notre site Ashford (Royaume-Uni). Notre site Vernier (CH) peut également être une option. Nos avantages - Soins de santé - Pension - Paid Time Off et congé familial - Régime de retraite - Company Discount Club #LI-Hybrid Chez Givaudan, vous contribuez à de délicieuses expériences de goût et de parfum qui touchent les gens. Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui proviennent de diverses cultures, milieux et expériences. Tout le monde — sans distinction de race, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, de handicap, de culture, de religion ou de circonstances personnelles — est chaleureusement accueilli à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Rejoignez-nous pour faire la différence ensemble.

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste EHS (lundi/mercredi/j) - Quel est votre prochain poste?

jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As an **EHS Specialist (m/w/d)**, you will directly report to our EHS Director and you will join our EHS Fragrances Department in **Vernier (Switzerland)**.

You will be part of a team of 4 EHS Specialists, and you will support the EHS Director on her daily job and specifically on one or more EHS specializations. You will also promote the EHS culture across the organization.

## In this exciting role you will :

- Be the main contact for specific Departments and act as back-up for others.
- Be the back-up of the EHS Director during her absences.
- Be customer-oriented with the desire of finding solutions with main partners when EHS issues are detected. Seek experts help if necessary.
- Organize regular site safety inspections with department/area owners; report findings and follow up their correction and prevention.
- Perform incident investigations and propose corrective actions to be implemented.
- Help on risk assessments and providing solutions to minimize risks.
- Assume the role of EHS Coordinator in the Crisis Management organisation.
- Follow up all audits findings, and evaluate the effectiveness of their corrective and preventive actions.
- Help on organizing site EHS committee meetings and following up all actions agreed in it.
- Keep good/regular liaisons with authorities related to Environment, Health and Safety; report to the EHS Director any clue of authority concerns.
- Conduct EHS Orientation training to new employees and contractors.
- Facilitate tool box meetings and deliver other EHS trainings.
- Help the development of EHS procedures and track their implementation.

## Your success profile includes:

- University degree in Chemistry, Engineering, EHS, or other related field
- Swiss Diploma “Ingénieur sécurité MSST” is a must
- Chargé de sécurité incendie is a plus
- At least 3 years of working experience in chemical/manufacturing industry
- 5+ years of experience in the EHS specialisation
- Fluent in French and knowledge of English
- Customer Focus
- Listening Skills

*For safety and hygiene reasons, please note that wearing a beard is not allowed in production roles.*

*Due to its activities, Givaudan is subject to the regulations of the OFAC (Office Fédéral de l'Aviation Civile). Please note that later in the recruitment process you will be asked to provide a criminal record.*

## Our Benefits :

Healthcare supportPaid time off and family leaveRetirement planSport and leisure clubsCompany shopStaff restaurantMobility allowance

Are you interested in this exciting challenge? We are looking forward to receiving your application! Please make sure you enclose your CV, Cover Letter, Diplomas and Work Certificates.

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Il tuo profilo di successo include: - Laurea in chimica, ingegneria, EHS o altro campo correlato - Diploma svizzero "Ingénieur sécurité MSST" è un must - Chargé de sécurité incendie è un vantaggio - Almeno 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore chimico/manifatturiero - Oltre 5 anni di esperienza nella specializzazione EHS - Ottima conoscenza del francese e della lingua inglese - Attenzione al cliente - Capacità di ascolto *Per motivi di sicurezza e igiene, si prega di notare che non è consentito indossare la barba durante la produzione ruoli.* *Per le sue attività, Givaudan è soggetta alla regolamentazione dell'OFAC (Office Fédéral de l'Aviation Civile). Tieni presente che più avanti nel processo di reclutamento ti verrà chiesto di fornire un casellario giudiziario.* I nostri vantaggi Supporto sanitario Ferie retribuite e congedi familiari Piano pensionistico Club sportivi e ricreativi Negozio aziendale Ristorante per il personale Indennità di mobilità Sei interessato a questa entusiasmante sfida? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura! Assicurati di allegare il tuo CV, lettera di presentazione, diplomi e certificati di lavoro. In Givaudan contribuisci a deliziose esperienze di gusto e profumo che toccano la vita delle persone. Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che provengono da culture, background ed esperienze diverse. Tutti, indipendentemente dalla razza, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'età, dalla disabilità, dalla cultura, dalla religione o da qualsiasi circostanza personale, sono accolti calorosamente a Givaudan, un luogo dove tutti amiamo essere e crescere. Ogni tua essenza arricchisce il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi per fare la differenza insieme.

Tout le monde, quels que soient sa race, son identité de genre, son orientation sexuelle, son âge, son handicap, sa culture, sa religion ou toute autre situation personnelle, est chaleureusement accueilli chez Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence ensemble.

jobs.title: Operativer Einkäufer 60-80% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Feiere gemeinsam mit uns die Schönheit menschlicher Erfahrungen. Gestalte mit Liebe zur Natur für ein glücklicheres, gesünderes Leben von Menschen. Gemeinsam, mit Herzlichkeit und Bescheidenheit, liefern wir Lebensmittelinnovationen, kreieren inspirierende Düfte und entwickeln Lösungen, mit denen Menschen gut aussehen und sich gut fühlen. Bei mehr als 17.000 Beschäftigten weltweit, die gemeinsam Ideen und Ziele erkunden, gibt es viel zu lernen und viele, von denen wir lernen können. Tauche ein in eine abwechslungsreiche, flexible und anregende Umgebung. Begegne Fachleuten mit echten Befugnissen, mit denen du partnerschaftlich zusammenarbeiten, Freunde finden und deine Fähigkeiten erweitern kannst. Jeden Tag prägen deine Energie, deine Kreativität und deine Entschlossenheit unsere Zukunft und beinflussen Milliarden von Menschen positiv. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Wir sind Givaudan. Human by nature.

Für unseren **Produktionsstandort in Volketswil** suchen wir einen engagierten und durchsetzungsstarken **Operativen Einkäufer** (m,w,d / 60–80 %).

In dieser vielseitigen Funktion bist du für die termingerechte Beschaffung von Geräten, technischen Betriebsmitteln sowie Rohstoffen verantwortlich und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherstellung unserer Produktionsprozesse. Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Produktion, Instandhaltung, EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) sowie Planung zusammen und fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson für operative Beschaffungsprozesse.

In dieser Funktion berichtest du direkt an den Leiter Planung.

## Deine Hauptaufgaben:

- Selbstständiges Erstellen und Nachverfolgen von IM&S-Bestellungen inklusive Überwachung der Liefertermine
- Unterstützung der Arbeitskollegen mit dem Bestelltool ARIBA
- Preisverhandlungen vom IM&S, vor Einkauf und bei Offerten
- Erstellen und Überwachen von Rohstoffbestellungen in SAP
- Problembehandlung bei Rohstoff- und IM&S-Einkauf: Korrespondenz mit Lieferanten und internen Mitarbeitern, Bearbeitung von Workflows und Notifikationen
- Aktive Unterstützung bei operativen Planungsaktivitäten
- Organisieren von Entsorgungen für den ganzen Standort

## Dein Profil:

- Kaufmännische Grundausbildung (EFZ) oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
- Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im operativen Einkauf, in der Beschaffung, Auftragsabwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion vorzugsweise innerhalb eines Industrie-, Produktions- oder technischen Unternehmens
- Erste Erfahrung in Preis- und Konditionsverhandlungen von Vorteil
- Gute Anwenderkenntnisse in SAP; Erfahrung mit ARIBA ist von Vorteil
- Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Serviceorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

## Welche zusätzlichen Vorteile bieten wir?

- Interessante Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage
- Vorteilhafte Pensionskassen Konditionen
- Gratis Firmenparkplatz und Bike-Badge
- Rabatt im Mitarbeiterladen in Kemptthal
- Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten im Givaudan-Sportclub
- REKA-Schecks und SBB-Halbtax Beteiligung
- Weltweiter privater Unfallversicherungsschutz und freie Wahl des Krankenhauses
- Zusätzliche freiwillige Familien- und Ausbildungszulagen

Bei Givaudan trägst du dazu bei, köstliche Geschmacks- und Dufterlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die aus vielfältigen Kulturen, Hintergründen und Erfahrungen entstehen. Jede Person – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlichen Lebensumständen – ist bei Givaudan herzlich willkommen, einem Ort, an dem wir alle gerne sind und wachsen.

Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Mach mit und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns eine bessere Zukunft.

Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che emergono da diverse culture, sfondi ed esperienze. Ogni persona – indipendentemente dall'etnia, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'età, dalla disabilità, dalla cultura, dalla religione o dalle circostanze personali – è il benvenuto a Givaudan, un luogo dove tutti noi apprezziamo essere e crescere. Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi e costruisci un futuro migliore insieme a noi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us in celebrating the beauty of human experience. Design with love for nature for happier, healthier lives for people. Together, with warmth and humility, we deliver food innovations, create inspiring scents and develop solutions that make people look and feel good. With more than 17,000 employees worldwide exploring ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many to learn from. Immerse yourself in a varied, flexible and stimulating environment. Meet professionals with real authority with whom you can work in partnership, make friends and expand your skills. Every day your energy, creativity and determination shape our future and positively impact billions of people. Every part of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature. We are looking for a committed and assertive operational buyer (m,f,d / 60-80%) for our production site in Volketswil. In this versatile role, you are responsible for the timely procurement of equipment, technical resources and raw materials, thereby making an important contribution to ensuring our production processes. You work closely with the production, maintenance, EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) and planning departments and act as the central contact for operational procurement processes. In this role, you report directly to the Head of Planning. Your main tasks - Independently creating and tracking IM&S orders including monitoring delivery dates - Supporting work colleagues with the ARIBA ordering tool - Price negotiations for IM&S, before purchasing and during offers - Creating and monitoring raw material orders in SAP - Troubleshooting raw material and IM&S purchasing Correspondence with suppliers and internal employees, processing workflows and notifications - Active support in operational planning activities - Organizing disposal for the entire site
• Your profile - Basic commercial training (EFZ) or comparable training - At least 3 years of professional experience in operational purchasing, procurement, order processing or a comparable function, preferably within an industrial, production or technical company - Initial experience in price and condition negotiations is an advantage - Good user knowledge of SAP; Experience with ARIBA is an advantage - Strong organizational skills as well as a structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working - High service orientation, strong communication skills and enjoyment of working with various internal and external stakeholders - Very good knowledge of German and good written and spoken English What additional advantages do we offer? - Interesting training and further education opportunities - Additional paid days off - Advantageous pension fund conditions - Free company parking space and bike badge - Discount in the employee shop in Kemptthal - Sports and leisure activities in the Givaudan sports club - REKA checks and SBB half-tax participation - Worldwide private accident insurance protection and free choice of hospital - Additional voluntary family and training allowances At Givaudan you help to create delicious To create taste and scent experiences that enrich people's lives. We value the different perspectives that arise from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Everyone – regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal circumstances – is welcome at Givaudan, a place where we all enjoy being and growing. Every part of you enriches our world. Join us and shape a better future together with us.

jobs.title: Global Head of Strategic Supply
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness, humility, and a spirit of adventure, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn from our 79 production sites worldwide, known for their best-in-class processes and procedures. There’s many to learn from, with high-performing leaders and caring colleagues to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your energy, your personality, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Global Head of Strategic Supply – Your future position?

Join Givaudan Fragrance & Beauty Operations and take a pivotal role in shaping how our division builds end-to-end supply resilience, agility, and strategic advantage. As **Global Head of Strategic Supply**, you will lead the global design and execution of inventory management and raw material supply strategies, alongside the coordination of the S&OP process that connects supply, demand, and business objectives across all regions.

Reporting directly to the **Global Head of Supply Chain**, you act as the architect and driving force behind the strategic supply framework that supports our growth ambitions, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction while contributing to optimize working capital and cash flow.

You will lead a diverse global team and serve as a critical link between Regional Supply Chain, Regional Supply, GBS and Procurement - ensuring that priorities and processes deliver maximum value to the business. This role offers the opportunity to influence global strategy, drive transformation, and inspire collaboration across our worldwide network.

**Flexible location the position can be based at any of our F&B Operations sites in Europe.**

## Your key responsibilities

## Strategic Leadership & Governance

- Define and maintain the global inventory and raw material supply strategies in collaboration with Procurement, ensuring alignment with cash flow targets, service levels, and sustainability objectives.
- Provide strategic supply inputs to the Global Operations business plans and contribute to the multiyear Supply Chain Strategy for the division.
- Govern and evolve the global **Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)** process to ensure visibility, standardization, and actionability across compounding and ingredient networks.
- Establish global supply governance parameters, ownership structures, and performance metrics to drive discipline and efficiency in all regions.

## Cross Functional Influence & Improvement

- Partner with Procurement on raw material supply risk management, allocation steering, and supplier collaboration for critical inputs.
- Enable operational transformation initiatives — including digital planning, network optimization, and footprint alignment — ensuring measurable performance improvements.
- Drive continuous improvement at enterprise scale, embedding data driven decision making through advanced analytics and system integration (SAP, BI/BO, etc.).
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and best‑practice transfer across planning teams globally, ensuring coherence and leverage of capabilities.
- Help design the Global Supply Roadmap in collaboration with the divisional supply functions and Solution Excellence organization.

## People & Organizational Development

- Lead, coach, and empower the global Strategic Supply team, fostering high performance, innovation, and collaboration.
- Shape talent succession and capability building in partnership with HR and Operations leadership, building the next generation of supply chain leaders.
- Champion inclusion, agility, and engagement as core elements of how the global planning community operates.

## You?

You are visionary leader who combines strategic insight with precise execution — able to connect global priorities with local realities, foster collaboration across functions, and continually raise the bar for supply performance. Success will depend on your ability to align operational strategy with business value while cultivating trust, engagement, and innovation throughout the Givaudan network.

## Your profile includes

- Master’s degree in Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or equivalent; MBA preferred.
- 15–20 years of end-to-end Supply Chain or Planning experience across international operations; experience in Procurement integration and complex transformation programs.
- Minimum 8–12 years in leadership roles with proven success in managing global teams and influencing executive stakeholders.
- Strong systems and analytics capability (SAP, BI/BO, advanced planning tools).
- Continuous improvement exposure (Six Sigma Black Belt or similar) and APICS certification desired.
- Fluent English; other languages advantageous.
- Skilled in cross-cultural collaboration, decision quality, and strategic communication.
- Excellent command of Microsoft Office and business analytics platforms.

## Our benefits

Attractive package with benefitsExcellent opportunities for progressive learning and developmentA creative team environment that will inspire you.

## PLEASE APPLY WITH ENGLISH CV.

#LI-hybrid

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness, humility, and a spirit of adventure, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn from our 79 production sites worldwide, known for their best-in-class processes and procedures. There’s many to learn from, with high-performing leaders and caring colleagues to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your energy, your personality, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Global Head of Strategic Supply – Your future position?

Join Givaudan Fragrance & Beauty Operations and take a pivotal role in shaping how our division builds end-to-end supply resilience, agility, and strategic advantage. As **Global Head of Strategic Supply**, you will lead the global design and execution of inventory management and raw material supply strategies, alongside the coordination of the S&OP process that connects supply, demand, and business objectives across all regions.

Reporting directly to the **Global Head of Supply Chain**, you act as the architect and driving force behind the strategic supply framework that supports our growth ambitions, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction while contributing to optimize working capital and cash flow.

You will lead a diverse global team and serve as a critical link between Regional Supply Chain, Regional Supply, GBS and Procurement - ensuring that priorities and processes deliver maximum value to the business. This role offers the opportunity to influence global strategy, drive transformation, and inspire collaboration across our worldwide network.

**Flexible location the position can be based at any of our F&B Operations sites in Europe.**

## Your key responsibilities

## Strategic Leadership & Governance

- Define and maintain the global inventory and raw material supply strategies in collaboration with Procurement, ensuring alignment with cash flow targets, service levels, and sustainability objectives.
- Provide strategic supply inputs to the Global Operations business plans and contribute to the multiyear Supply Chain Strategy for the division.
- Govern and evolve the global **Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)** process to ensure visibility, standardization, and actionability across compounding and ingredient networks.
- Establish global supply governance parameters, ownership structures, and performance metrics to drive discipline and efficiency in all regions.

## Cross Functional Influence & Improvement

- Partner with Procurement on raw material supply risk management, allocation steering, and supplier collaboration for critical inputs.
- Enable operational transformation initiatives — including digital planning, network optimization, and footprint alignment — ensuring measurable performance improvements.
- Drive continuous improvement at enterprise scale, embedding data driven decision making through advanced analytics and system integration (SAP, BI/BO, etc.).
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and best‑practice transfer across planning teams globally, ensuring coherence and leverage of capabilities.
- Help design the Global Supply Roadmap in collaboration with the divisional supply functions and Solution Excellence organization.

## People & Organizational Development

- Lead, coach, and empower the global Strategic Supply team, fostering high performance, innovation, and collaboration.
- Shape talent succession and capability building in partnership with HR and Operations leadership, building the next generation of supply chain leaders.
- Champion inclusion, agility, and engagement as core elements of how the global planning community operates.

## You?

You are visionary leader who combines strategic insight with precise execution — able to connect global priorities with local realities, foster collaboration across functions, and continually raise the bar for supply performance. Success will depend on your ability to align operational strategy with business value while cultivating trust, engagement, and innovation throughout the Givaudan network.

## Your profile includes

- Master’s degree in Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or equivalent; MBA preferred.
- 15–20 years of end-to-end Supply Chain or Planning experience across international operations; experience in Procurement integration and complex transformation programs.
- Minimum 8–12 years in leadership roles with proven success in managing global teams and influencing executive stakeholders.
- Strong systems and analytics capability (SAP, BI/BO, advanced planning tools).
- Continuous improvement exposure (Six Sigma Black Belt or similar) and APICS certification desired.
- Fluent English; other languages advantageous.
- Skilled in cross-cultural collaboration, decision quality, and strategic communication.
- Excellent command of Microsoft Office and business analytics platforms.

## Our benefits

Attractive package with benefitsExcellent opportunities for progressive learning and developmentA creative team environment that will inspire you.

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. Human by nature.

## Head of Procurement Ingredients - Your future position?

You will require to establish a clear segment vision with focus on value creation and bottom line – aligned with the current strategy goals and targets. You will develop and implement category strategies to achieve sustainable reductions in spend aligned with Division strategies. Actively engage and represent Procurement with key segment stakeholders. You will also operate in close collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial Organization, GBS and the respective business partners. Lead & develop CatMan teams.

**Location**Vernier or Shanghai

**Reporting to**Deputy Head of Procurement F&B

## In this exciting role, you will be responsible for

## Alignment of Strategies

- Establish joint commitments with a clear focus on business impact & winning with customers
- Develop/validate the annual Procurement Plan and budget within the segment. Agree priorities, sourcing strategies and timelines with stakeholders
- Create a vision that consistently delivers value to the segment through our Procurement current strategy of Competitive Advantage, Resilient Supply Chain and Sustainability.
- Actively support the responsible sourcing, sourcing4good project and the Scope 3 reduction journey.

## Partnership

- Represent the segment Procurement Categories in business review meetings as appropriate. Ensure information flow between the related segment and the Procurement Category management organization to effectively deliver against business/functional strategies
- Participate in the Global S&OP for Ingredients and work closely with Global Procurement Management/Supply Chain Management /Pricing heads/Ingredients Manufacturing Management.
- Proactively communicate relevant decisions and market trends, and inform about potential RM issues
- Establish a stakeholder engagement plan
- Fosters strong relationships with key suppliers within the segment in alignment with the strategy

## Sourcing Strategy

- Drive the development and implementation of category strategies aligned with the global Procurement strategy
- Monitor achievements against business goals and periodically reassess the targets.
- Promote Market Intelligence

## Portfolio Management

- Negotiate contracts and manage vendor partnerships globally
- Identify opportunities for portfolio optimization and actively involve creation and manufacturing in development of optimization plans
- Own key supplier relationship, and lead key supplier conflict resolutions
- Ensure adequate contract cover for materials and supplier compliance to contracts
- Ensure vendor performance at target levels
- 20-50% travel required

## People Management

- Build and develop a global category management organization
- Lead & develop the Category Managers in your team – on sourcing strategy, priority setting and communication to relevant stakeholder and resource optimization
- Attract and train the necessary talent to build a distinctive organization
- Develop a strong succession plan and promote high potentials and address performance gaps

## Your professional profile includes

- More than 10-15 years’ of experience in Procurement/Commercial and/or OPS organisations

- Attract and train the necessary talent to build a distinctive organization
- Develop a strong succession plan and promote high potentials and address performance gaps

## Assurer la Prévention des accidents :

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a noi e celebriamo insieme la bellezza dell’esperienza umana. Partecipa alla creazione di vite più felici e più sane, con amore per la natura. Insieme, con gentilezza, umiltà e spirito di avventura, proponiamo innovazioni per il cibo, profumi ispirati al design e sviluppiamo soluzioni per la bellezza e il benessere. C'è così tanto da scoprire nei nostri 79 siti produttivi in ​​tutto il mondo, famosi per i loro processi e procedure all'avanguardia. C'è così tanto da imparare da leader brillanti e colleghi premurosi con cui esplorare le tue idee e promuovere le tue ambizioni. Ogni giorno, la tua energia, personalità e determinazione daranno forma al nostro futuro e faranno la differenza per miliardi di persone. Il nostro mondo è arricchito dalle vostre differenze. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura. Leader del team di produzione chimica 2x8 (m/f/d) - Il tuo prossimo lavoro? In qualità di leader del team di produzione chimica 2x8 (m/f/d), sei assegnato al nostro dipartimento di produzione chimica e riferisci al nostro supervisore della produzione chimica. Sarai responsabile di fornire supporto al responsabile della produzione supervisionando e coordinando le attività quotidiane del team di produzione degli ingredienti. Garantisci che i prodotti intermedi o finiti siano consegnati in conformità con le specifiche di produzione stabilite, rispettando gli standard di sicurezza, qualità, costo e livello di servizio. Sei interessato a questa posizione? Questa potrebbe essere l'occasione perfetta se, come noi, il tuo obiettivo è soddisfare sempre le esigenze dei clienti e toccare le emozioni del mondo che ti circonda. La tua missione principale Gestire la produzione chimica degli ingredienti - Sarai responsabile della supervisione della produzione degli ingredienti in conformità con il piano di produzione, seguendo le procedure operative preparate dal chimico di produzione o dal responsabile del processo, per garantire resa e qualità standard; - Assisterai il supervisore nello svolgimento di compiti amministrativi; - Ti occuperai di gestire e pianificare la produzione rispettando priorità e scadenze; - Interverrai nelle diverse fasi del processo, monitorerai la produttività e adeguerai le risorse materiali e dipendenti se necessario; - Assisterai il supervisore della produzione nel funzionamento delle strutture dell'area di produzione in modo tempestivo in modo che tutte le macchine e le attrezzature funzionino in sicurezza; - Garantirai il rispetto del programma di produzione, delle istruzioni e delle scadenze; - Garantirai che le strutture e le attrezzature siano utilizzate correttamente e che le norme di controllo interno siano implementate; - Monitorerai l'inventario per garantire la disponibilità delle materie prime necessarie per le operazioni; - Fungerai da supporto al chimico e al supervisore al fine di mantenere la competitività dei costi, attraverso miglioramenti tecnici o operativi. Management - Sarai responsabile della supervisione quotidiana del tuo team, comunicando direttive e informazioni durante le riunioni quotidiane; - Organizzerai la distribuzione del lavoro e del personale in base alle priorità e alle diverse posizioni produttive; - Formerai i dipendenti presso la loro postazione di lavoro e ti occuperai di accrescere le loro competenze in un'ottica di costante miglioramento continuo; - Monitorerai le prestazioni e valuterai la tua squadra con il supervisore di supporto; - Sarai il braccio destro del supervisore della Produzione Ingredienti, e lo sostituirai in caso di sua assenza; - Devi essere un modello, uno dei garanti del rispetto delle norme in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente e ti assicurerai che i dipendenti esercitino la massima vigilanza; - Interverrai e darai istruzioni in linea con la politica aziendale in materia di igiene, sicurezza e tutela dell'ambiente. Tu? Vuoi evolverti e dare forma alla tua carriera professionale a modo tuo? Vuoi entrare a far parte di un'azienda che promuove il lavoro di squadra? Vuoi collaborare e imparare con un team tanto qualificato quanto appassionato della propria professione? Allora unisciti a noi e dai un senso alla tua carriera! Inviaci il tuo file completo, CV, lettera di presentazione, diploma! Il tuo profilo - Possiedi un CFC in Tecnologo delle Produzioni Chimiche e Farmaceutiche o titolo ritenuto equivalente; - Hai da 5 a 8 anni di esperienza nella produzione chimica; - Sei particolarmente riconosciuto per la tua padronanza dei processi chimici, delle tecniche specifiche della professione e degli impianti chimici; - Hai una perfetta padronanza del francese. La conoscenza fluente dell'inglese costituirebbe un vantaggio; - Hai un'ottima conoscenza degli strumenti IT come Microsoft Office, SAP e Google App; - Hai un'ottima mente analitica e sei proattivo; - Sei organizzato per natura con un'eccellente gestione delle priorità; - Hai ottime capacità di comunicazione e ascolto, sei naturalmente orientato al cliente; - Dimostri un atteggiamento proattivo nei confronti dei cambiamenti e delle iniziative di miglioramento continuo sul sito. Per motivi di sicurezza e igiene, si ricorda che non è consentito portare la barba nelle funzioni produttive. I nostri vantaggi - Partecipazione al premio dell'assicurazione sanitaria - Fondo pensione vantaggioso - Negozio per il personale, accesso ai prodotti Givaudan - Attività sportive e ricreative - Ristorante aziendale a prezzi ridotti - Sussidio per la mobilità Sei interessato a questa entusiasmante sfida? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura! Assicurati di allegare il tuo CV, lettera di presentazione, diplomi e certificati di lavoro. In Givaudan contribuisci a creare esperienze sensoriali e olfattive uniche che toccano e ispirano la vita quotidiana di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Siamo ispirati e guidati da uno spirito di squadra che ci consente di evolvere, collaborare e migliorare le nostre competenze lavorando a fianco di team diversi, qualificati e appassionati della loro professione, indipendentemente dalla loro regione o divisione dell'azienda. Il nostro mondo è arricchito dalle vostre differenze. Givaudan si impegna a favore delle pari opportunità. Pertanto, accogliamo con favore le candidature indipendentemente dall'origine culturale e sociale, dal sesso, dall'età, dalla religione o dall'identità sessuale. Disponiamo inoltre di un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, di condizioni di lavoro progressiste e siamo certificati come datore di lavoro che garantisce la parità di retribuzione per uomini e donne.

Chemical production team leader 2x8 (m/f/d) - Your next job? As a Chemical Production Team Leader 2x8 (m/f/d), you are attached to our Chemical Production department and report to our Chemical Production Supervisor. You will be responsible for providing support to the production manager by supervising and coordinating the daily activities of the ingredient manufacturing team. You guarantee that intermediate or finished products are delivered in accordance with established production specifications, while respecting safety, quality, cost and service level standards. Are you interested in this position? This could be the perfect opportunity if, like us, your goal is to always meet customer needs and touch the emotions of the world around you. Your Main Mission Managing the Chemical Production of Ingredients - You will be responsible for supervising the manufacturing of ingredients in accordance with the manufacturing plan, following the operating procedures prepared by the production chemist or process manager, to ensure standard yield and quality; - You will assist the supervisor in carrying out administrative tasks; - You will be in charge of managing and planning production while respecting priorities and deadlines; - You will intervene at different stages of the process, you will monitor productivity and adjust material and employee resources if necessary; - You will assist the production supervisor in the operation of production area facilities in a timely manner so that all machines and equipment are operated safely; - You will ensure compliance with the manufacturing program, instructions and deadlines; - You will ensure that facilities and equipment are correctly used and that internal control regulations are implemented; - You will monitor inventory to ensure the availability of raw materials required for operations; - You will act as support to the chemist and supervisor in order to maintain cost competitiveness, through technical or operational improvements. Management - You will be responsible for supervising your team on a daily basis, communicating directives and information during daily meetings; - You will organize the distribution of work and personnel according to priorities and different manufacturing positions; - You will train employees at their workstation and you will be responsible for increasing their skills with a view to constant continuous improvement; - You will monitor performance and evaluate your team with the supporting supervisor; - You will be the right hand of the Ingredient Production supervisor, and you will replace him in the event of his absence; - You must be a role model, one of the guarantors of compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental rules and you will ensure that employees exercise the greatest vigilance; - You will intervene and give instructions in line with the company's policy on Hygiene, Safety and Environmental Protection. You? Do you want to evolve and shape your professional career in your own way? Do you want to join a company that promotes teamwork? Do you want to collaborate and learn with a team that is as qualified as they are passionate about their profession? So join us and give meaning to your career! Send us your complete file, CV, cover letter, diploma! Your
• Profile - You have a CFC in Technologist in Chemical and Pharmaceutical Production or a title deemed equivalent; - You have 5 to 8 years of experience in chemical production; - You are particularly recognized for your mastery of chemical processes, techniques specific to the profession and chemical installations; - You have a perfect command of French. Fluency in English would be an asset; - You have very good knowledge of IT tools such as Microsoft Office, SAP and Google App; - You have an excellent analytical mind and you are proactive; - You are organized by nature with excellent priority management; - You have excellent communication and listening skills, you are naturally customer oriented; - You demonstrate a proactive attitude towards changes and continuous improvement initiatives on the site. For safety and hygiene reasons, please note that wearing a beard is not permitted in production functions. Our advantages - Participation in the health insurance premium - Advantageous pension fund - Staff store, access to Givaudan products - Sports and leisure activities - Company restaurant with reduced prices - Subsidy for mobility Are you interested in this exciting challenge? We look forward to receiving your application! Be sure to attach your CV, cover letter, diplomas and work certificates. At Givaudan, you help create unique sensory and olfactory experiences that touch and inspire the daily lives of many people around the world. We are inspired and driven by a team spirit that allows us to evolve, collaborate and enhance our skills by working alongside diverse teams, qualified and passionate about their profession, regardless of their regions or divisions in the company. Our world is enriched by your differences. Givaudan is committed to equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications regardless of cultural and social origin, gender, age, religion or sexual identity. We also have a safe working environment, progressive working conditions and are certified as an employer guaranteeing equal pay for men and women.

jobs.title: Patent Attorney (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As a qualified Patent Attorney (m/f/d) you will be a trusted advisor to our global Flavour &Fragrances & Active Beauty, S&T management teams, as well as to adjacent business functions. You will play a key role in driving and executing Givaudan’s corporate intellectual property (IP) strategy and objectives.

You will report to the Head of Global Intellectual Property and are based in our office in Zug, Switzerland.

## Your role

- Provide legal advice on intellectual property issues.
- Manage relationship with S+T managers across F&F & AB, and adjacent business functions to effectively manage their IP portfolios
- Providing Head of IP with periodic reports of key issues and activities
- Mentoring junior colleagues.
- IP portfolio management Drafting, filing, prosecution and maintenance of a portfolio of patents
- Drafting and negotiating IP related aspects of third party agreements
- Risk Management
- Supporting Head of IP in leading negotiations to resolve third party IP disputes and other contentious proceedings
- Representing the IP department at S&T business platform or Centre of Excellence level management meetings

## Your profile includes

- Qualification as a European Patent Attorney or an equivalent national qualification. Preference for dual qualification, that is, European Patent Attorney and a registered attorney before a relevant national office, such as US, UK, or DE offices
- Advanced degree (at least Masters level, and preferably a PhD) in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. chemical/Biological science)
- 5 years post-qualification experience in either a law-firm or an industrial practice
- Fluent English
- Thorough knowledge of patent and intellectual property laws globally
- Knowledge in drafting and negotiating intellectual property aspects of agreements with third parties
- In-depth knowledge of the fragrances, food and Cosmetics industry

## Our benefits

- 40 hour working week with flexible working model and remote working
- Additional paid days off
- Favorable pension fund contributions
- Sport and leisure club (amenities/showers on site)
- Discounts at the company shop
- Free Staff Parking
- Subsidized REKA vouchers and SBB half fare travelcard
- Complimentary beverages (tea, coffee, water)
- Worldwide private accident coverage and free choice of hospital

#LI-Hybrid

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As a qualified Patent Attorney (m/f/d) you will be a trusted advisor to our global Flavour &Fragrances & Active Beauty, S&T management teams, as well as to adjacent business functions. You will play a key role in driving and executing Givaudan’s corporate intellectual property (IP) strategy and objectives.

You will report to the Head of Global Intellectual Property and are based in our office in Zug, Switzerland.

## Your role

- Provide legal advice on intellectual property issues.
- Manage relationship with S+T managers across F&F & AB, and adjacent business functions to effectively manage their IP portfolios
- Providing Head of IP with periodic reports of key issues and activities
- Mentoring junior colleagues.
- IP portfolio management Drafting, filing, prosecution and maintenance of a portfolio of patents
- Drafting and negotiating IP related aspects of third party agreements
- Risk Management
- Supporting Head of IP in leading negotiations to resolve third party IP disputes and other contentious proceedings
- Representing the IP department at S&T business platform or Centre of Excellence level management meetings

## Your profile includes

- Qualification as a European Patent Attorney or an equivalent national qualification. Preference for dual qualification, that is, European Patent Attorney and a registered attorney before a relevant national office, such as US, UK, or DE offices
- Advanced degree (at least Masters level, and preferably a PhD) in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. chemical/Biological science)
- 5 years post-qualification experience in either a law-firm or an industrial practice
- Fluent English
- Thorough knowledge of patent and intellectual property laws globally
- Knowledge in drafting and negotiating intellectual property aspects of agreements with third parties
- In-depth knowledge of the fragrances, food and Cosmetics industry

## Our benefits

- 40 hour working week with flexible working model and remote working
- Additional paid days off
- Favorable pension fund contributions
- Sport and leisure club (amenities/showers on site)
- Discounts at the company shop
- Free Staff Parking
- Subsidized REKA vouchers and SBB half fare travelcard
- Complimentary beverages (tea, coffee, water)
- Worldwide private accident coverage and free choice of hospital

jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As **Head of the Fragrance Ingredients Business**, you will provide global leadership, ensuring cohesive execution of the company’s commercial and marketing strategies. You will align regional priorities and global customer objectives with the overall company direction and act as the key interface between divisional strategy, annual targets, and market execution. In this role, you will support sales performance, set team direction, and foster cross‑functional collaboration across the organisation to strengthen the division’s market presence and customer relationships for our Ingredients portfolio.

This position reports to the Global Head of S&T Fragrances and is based in Vernier, Switzerland.

## Your key responsibilities include

- Translate divisional commercial and marketing strategies into actionable business area objectives, providing clear targets and guidance to regional Sales and global Marketing teams.
- Support divisional management in monitoring global business performance, including sales outcomes, marketing initiatives, and portfolio evolution.
- Lead the implementation of global marketing plans and pricing strategies to ensure a consistent company presence and competitive positioning across markets.
- Partner with regional teams, creation, and operations functions to drive customer engagement and coordinated go‑to‑market execution that delivers value‑adding solutions.
- Facilitate global alignment in product portfolio management, marketing messaging, and sales approaches.
- Coordinate divisional projects such as portfolio rationalisation, customer segmentation, and strategic account frameworks.
- Ensure consistent application of global sales processes, forecasting methodologies, and performance dashboards.
- Lead the global Business Area team, reinforcing collaboration and knowledge sharing between Sales, Marketing, and supporting functions.
- Represent the Fragrance Ingredients Business within divisional and corporate forums, contributing strategic insights from both market and commercial dimensions.
- Liaise with cross‑functional partners - Finance, Operations, HR, EHS, Regulatory, and Innovation - to ensure efficient and compliant commercial operations.
- Track market and competitor trends, providing strategic recommendations on opportunities, challenges, and marketing priorities.
- Contribute to planning and budgeting cycles, ensuring the right balance between sales targets and marketing resources.

## Your profile

You thrive on leading and uniting global teams around shared commercial and marketing goals. With a global mindset and a hands‑on approach, you collaborate effectively across functions and regions. You bring strong business acumen and creativity, connecting customer needs with divisional capabilities, while remaining committed to compliance, sustainability, and responsible business growth.

## Your professional profile include

- Advanced degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a closely related field.
- Over 20 years’ experience in senior leadership roles within international organisations.
- Proven success leading integrated Sales and Marketing functions, ideally within the fragrance or specialty ingredients industry.
- Strong background in commercial strategy, global account management, and marketing communications.
- Deep knowledge of B2B commercial models, marketing frameworks, and portfolio management processes.
- Advanced analytical and strategic planning skills.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
- Fluent in English and French is an advantage

## Our benefits

- Healthcare support
• Paid Time Off and family leave
• Retirement plan• Sport and leisure clubs
• Company shop
• Staff restaurant
• Mobility allowance

Collaborare con partner interfunzionali: finanza, operazioni, risorse umane, EHS, regolamentazione e innovazione - per garantire operazioni commerciali efficienti e conformi. - Monitorare le tendenze del mercato e della concorrenza, fornendo consigli strategici su opportunità, sfide e priorità di marketing. - Contribuire ai cicli di pianificazione e budget, garantendo il giusto equilibrio tra obiettivi di vendita e risorse di marketing. Il tuo profilo Puoi prosperare guidando e unendo team globali attorno a obiettivi commerciali e di marketing condivisi. Con una mentalità globale e un approccio pratico, collabori in modo efficace tra funzioni e regioni. Apporta un forte senso degli affari e creatività, collegando le esigenze dei clienti con le capacità divisionali, pur rimanendo impegnato per la conformità, la sostenibilità e la crescita aziendale responsabile. Il tuo profilo professionale include: Laurea avanzata in Economia aziendale, Marketing o un campo strettamente correlato. - Oltre 20 anni di esperienza in ruoli di leadership all'interno di organizzazioni internazionali. - Comprovato successo alla guida di funzioni integrate di vendita e marketing, idealmente nel settore delle fragranze o degli ingredienti speciali. - Forte esperienza nella strategia commerciale, nella gestione degli account globali e nelle comunicazioni di marketing. - Conoscenza approfondita dei modelli commerciali B2B, dei framework di marketing e dei processi di gestione del portafoglio. - Avanzate capacità analitiche e di pianificazione strategica. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e gestione degli stakeholder. - Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. Seien Sie dabei und feiern Sie die Schönheit der menschlichen Erfahrung. Schaffen Sie mit Liebe zur Natur ein glücklicheres und gesünderes Leben. Ihr Profil Sie leben davon, globale Teams im Hinblick auf gemeinsame Geschäfts- und Marketingziele zu leiten und zu vereinen. Mit einer globalen Denkweise und einem praxisorientierten Ansatz arbeiten Sie effektiv über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zusammen. Sie bringen ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und Kreativität mit, verbinden Kundenbedürfnisse mit den Fähigkeiten der Abteilung und bleiben gleichzeitig der Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Nachhaltigkeit und verantwortungsvollem Geschäftswachstum verpflichtet. Rejoignez-nous et célébrez la beauté de l'expérience humaine. Créez pour une vie plus heureuse et plus saine, avec amour pour la nature. Ensemble, avec passion et créativité, nous proposons des innovations alimentaires, créons des parfums inspirés et développons des solutions de beauté et de bien-être. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre, avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde avec qui explorer des idées et des ambitions. Chaque jour, votre talent, votre esprit d'innovation et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir, faisant une différence positive pour des milliards de personnes. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. Humain par nature. En tant que responsable de l’activité Ingrédients de parfumerie, vous assurerez un leadership mondial, garantissant l’exécution cohérente des stratégies commerciales et marketing de l’entreprise. Vous alignerez les priorités régionales et les objectifs mondiaux des clients avec l’orientation globale de l’entreprise et agirez en tant qu’interface clé entre la stratégie de la division, les objectifs annuels et l’exécution du marché. Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez les performances commerciales, définirez la direction de l’équipe et favoriserez la collaboration interfonctionnelle au sein de l’organisation afin de renforcer la présence de la division sur le marché et les relations clients pour notre portefeuille d’ingrédients. Ce poste relève du responsable mondial des parfums S&T et est basé à Vernier, en Suisse. Vos principales responsabilités comprennent : - Traduire les stratégies commerciales et marketing de la division en objectifs opérationnels du secteur d'activité, en fournissant des objectifs et des conseils clairs aux équipes régionales de vente et de marketing mondiales. - Soutenir la direction de la division dans le suivi des performances commerciales mondiales, y compris les résultats des ventes, les initiatives marketing et l'évolution du portefeuille. - Diriger la mise en œuvre de plans marketing mondiaux et de stratégies de tarification pour assurer une présence cohérente de l'entreprise et un positionnement concurrentiel sur tous les marchés. - Collaborer avec les équipes régionales, les fonctions de création et d'exploitation pour stimuler l'engagement des clients et une exécution coordonnée de la mise sur le marché qui offre des solutions à valeur ajoutée. - Faciliter l'alignement global de la gestion du portefeuille de produits, des messages marketing et des approches commerciales. - Coordonner les projets divisionnaires tels que la rationalisation du portefeuille, la segmentation de la clientèle et les cadres de comptes stratégiques. - Assurer une application cohérente des processus de vente mondiaux, des méthodologies de prévision et des tableaux de bord de performance. - Diriger l'équipe mondiale du secteur d'activité, en renforçant la collaboration et le partage des connaissances entre les ventes, le marketing et les fonctions de support. - Représenter l'activité Ingrédients de Parfum au sein des forums de division et d'entreprise, en apportant des informations stratégiques sur les dimensions du marché et commerciales. - Assurer la liaison avec les partenaires interfonctionnels - Finances, Opérations, RH, EHS, Réglementation et Innovation - pour garantir des opérations commerciales efficaces et conformes. - Suivre les tendances du marché et des concurrents, en fournissant des recommandations stratégiques sur les opportunités, les défis et les priorités marketing. - Contribuer aux cycles de planification et de budgétisation, en assurant le bon équilibre entre les objectifs de vente et les ressources marketing. Votre profil Vous aimez diriger et fédérer des équipes mondiales autour d'objectifs commerciaux et marketing communs. Avec un état d'esprit mondial et une approche pratique, vous collaborez efficacement entre les fonctions et les régions. Vous faites preuve d'un sens aigu des affaires et d'une grande créativité, reliant les besoins des clients aux capacités de la division, tout en restant engagé envers la conformité, la durabilité et la croissance responsable de l'entreprise. Votre profil professionnel comprend : - Un diplôme supérieur en administration des affaires, en marketing ou dans un domaine étroitement lié. - Plus de 20 ans d'expérience dans des postes de direction au sein d'organisations internationales. - Succès avéré dans la direction de fonctions intégrées de vente et de marketing, idéalement dans l'industrie des parfums ou des ingrédients de spécialité. - Solide expérience en stratégie commerciale, en gestion de comptes mondiaux et en communications marketing. - Connaissance approfondie des modèles commerciaux B2B, des cadres marketing et des processus de gestion de portefeuille. - Compétences avancées en matière d'analyse et de planification stratégique. - Excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de gestion des parties prenantes. - Anglais courant ; des langues supplémentaires sont un avantage. jobs.description:
Feiere gemeinsam mit uns die Schönheit menschlicher Erfahrungen. Gestalte mit Liebe zur Natur für ein glücklicheres, gesünderes Leben von Menschen. Gemeinsam, mit Leidenschaft und Kreativität, liefern wir Lebensmittelinnovationen, kreieren inspirierende Düfte und entwickeln Lösungen für die Schönheit und das Wohlbefinden von Menschen. Bei mehr als 17.000 Beschäftigten weltweit, die gemeinsam Ideen und Ziele erkunden, gibt es viel zu lernen und viele, von denen wir lernen können. Dein Talent, dein Innovationsgeist und deine Entschlossenheit prägen tagtäglich unsere Zukunft und beeinflussen Milliarden von Menschen positiv. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Wir sind Givaudan. Human by nature.

Die **Naturex AG, ein Unternehmen der Givaudan Gruppe**, ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter hochwertiger Frucht- und Gemüsepulver für die Lebensmittel- und Babyfood-Industrie. An unseren Produktionsstandorten Bischofszell (TG) und Burgdorf (BE) verbinden wir höchste Qualitätsstandards mit nachhaltigen und innovativen Lösungen – für Kundinnen und Kunden auf der ganzen Welt.

Für unser Labor in **Burgdorf** suchen wir dich als **Quality Assurance & Sample Technician** (m/w/d). In dieser vielseitigen Funktion führst du chemisch-physikalische Analysen an Roh-, Zusatz- und Hilfsstoffen sowie an Zwischen- und Endprodukten zur Herstellung von Frucht- und Gemüsepulvern durch und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherstellung unserer hohen Qualitätsstandards.

## Deine Aufgaben

- Durchführung chemisch-physikalischer Analysen sowie sensorischer Beurteilungen von Roh-, Zusatz- und Hilfsstoffen sowie Zwischen- und Endprodukten
- Durchführung und Verwaltung mikrobiologischer Analysen, Bearbeitung von Proben sowie Durchführung des wöchentlichen Hygiene-Monitorings inklusive Abstrichentnahmen.
- Probenahme, Aufbereitung, Verteilung, Rückstellung sowie Verwaltung der Proben über den gesamten Analyseprozess
- Selbstständige Kalibrierung und Wartung von Laborgeräten im eigenen Arbeitsbereich
- Übernahme allgemeiner administrativer Aufgaben rund um die Laborinfrastruktur, wie die Verwaltung von Chemikalien, Verbrauchsmaterialien und die Entsorgung
- Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Analysemethoden
- Organisation und Versand von Mustern
- Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze für Proben- und Abstrichentnahmen

## Dein Profil

- Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittelbranche
- Erfahrung im Bereich Labor und Analytik; Kenntnisse in der Sensorik sind von Vorteil
- Präzise und effiziente Arbeitsweise mit hohem Hygienebewusstsein nach festgelegten Vorgaben und Qualitätsstandards
- Gute Computerkenntnisse sowie praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Microsoft Excel
- Selbstständige, zuverlässige und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit
- Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit sowie gutes Organisationsgeschick
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

## Was zeichnet Naturex aus?

- Spannende Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- 20% Ermässigung auf REKA Checks
- Kostenlose Parkplätze an unseren Standorten
- Diverse Prämierungen (Safety/Quality/Saving (Idee 499))
- Rabatt im Mitarbeitershop
- Top CC Karte
- Möglichkeit zum Ferienkauf von bis zu 10 Tagen pro Jahr
- 100 % Übernahme des Abzugs für die Krankentaggeldversicherung
- SUVA top up Versicherung
- Beteiligung am Halbtax-Abonnement
- Beteiligung am Fitnessabo
- Bezahlter Vorbereitsungskurs für die Pensionierung

Celebrate with us the beauty of human experiences. Create with love for nature for a happier, healthier life of people. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, create inspiring fragrances and develop solutions for the beauty and well-being of people. With more than 17,000 employees worldwide exploring ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many to learn from. Your talent, innovation and determination shape our future every day and positively impact billions of people. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature. Naturex AG, a company of the Givaudan Group, is a world-leading supplier of high-quality fruit and vegetable powders for the food and baby food industry. At our production sites Bischofszell (TG) and Burgdorf (BE), we combine the highest quality standards with sustainable and innovative solutions – for customers all over the world. For our laboratory in Burgdorf we are looking for you as Quality Assurance & Sample Technician (m/f/d). In this versatile function, you carry out chemical-physical analyses on raw materials, additives and auxiliary materials as well as on intermediate and final products for the production of fruit and vegetable powders and thus make an important contribution to ensuring our high quality standards.
• Your tasks - carrying out chemical-physical analyses as well as sensory assessments of raw materials, additives and auxiliary materials as well as intermediate and end products - carrying out and managing microbiological analyses, processing of samples and carrying out weekly hygiene monitoring including swabs. - Sampling, processing, distribution, provision and management of samples throughout the analysis process - Independent calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment in its own work area - Assuming general administrative tasks related to laboratory infrastructure, such as the management of chemicals, consumables and disposal - Collaboration in the development and optimisation of analytical methods - Organisation and shipment of samples - Readiness for occasional night and weekend use of samples and swabs
• Your profile - Professional experience in the food industry - Laboratory and analytical experience; Knowledge of sensor technology is advantageous - Precise and efficient working methods with high hygiene awareness according to defined specifications and quality standards - Good computer skills as well as practical experience in dealing with Microsoft Excel - Self-employed, reliable and responsible personality - Strong team skills as well as good organization skills - Very good knowledge of German in words and writing, English skills of advantage What distinguishes Naturex? - Exciting training and further education opportunities - 20% discount on REKA checks - Free parking at our locations - Various awards (Safety/Quality/Saving (idea 499)) - Discount in the employee shop - Top CC card - Possibility to buy a holiday allowance - Top up insurance - SUVA - Participation in the half-tax subscription - Participation in the fitness subscription - Paid preparation course for retirement At Givaudan you contribute to creating delicious taste and fragrance experiences that enrich people's lives. We value the different perspectives that emerge from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every person – regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal circumstances – is welcome at Givaudan, a place where we all enjoy being and growing. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. Join us and build a better future together with us.

Avec passion et créativité, nous livrons des innovations alimentaires, créons des parfums inspirants et développons des solutions pour la beauté et le bien-être des gens. Avec plus de 17 000 employés à travers le monde qui explorent ensemble des idées et des objectifs, il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre. Votre talent, votre innovation et votre détermination façonnent notre avenir chaque jour et affectent positivement des milliards de personnes. Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine. Naturex AG, une société du Groupe Givaudan, est un fournisseur leader mondial de poudres de fruits et légumes de haute qualité pour l'industrie alimentaire et alimentaire pour bébés. Sur nos sites de production Bischofszell (TG) et Burgdorf (BE), nous combinons les normes de qualité les plus élevées avec des solutions durables et innovantes – pour les clients du monde entier. Pour notre laboratoire de Burgdorf, nous vous recherchons en tant que Technicien en Assurance Qualité et Échantillonnage (m/f/d). Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous effectuez des analyses chimiques-physiques sur les matières premières, les additifs et les matériaux auxiliaires ainsi que sur les produits intermédiaires et finaux pour la production de poudres de fruits et légumes et contribuez ainsi de manière importante à garantir nos normes de qualité élevées.
• Vos tâches - effectuer des analyses chimiques et physiques ainsi que des évaluations sensorielles des matières premières, des additifs et des matériaux auxiliaires ainsi que des produits intermédiaires et finaux - effectuer et gérer des analyses microbiologiques, le traitement des échantillons et effectuer une surveillance hebdomadaire de l'hygiène, y compris les écouvillons. - L'échantillonnage, le traitement, la distribution, la fourniture et la gestion des échantillons tout au long du processus d'analyse - L'étalonnage et l'entretien indépendants de l'équipement de laboratoire dans son propre domaine de travail - En supposant des tâches administratives générales liées à l'infrastructure de laboratoire, telles que la gestion des produits chimiques, des consommables et de l'élimination - La collaboration dans le développement et l'optimisation des méthodes d'analyse - L'organisation et l'expédition des échantillons - La préparation pour l'utilisation occasionnelle nuit et week-end d'échantillons et d'écouvillons
• Votre profil - Expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie alimentaire - Expérience de laboratoire et d'analyse; La connaissance de la technologie des capteurs est avantageuse - Des méthodes de travail précises et efficaces avec une bonne connaissance de l'hygiène selon les spécifications et les normes de qualité définies - Bonnes compétences informatiques ainsi que l'expérience pratique dans le traitement de Microsoft Excel - Personnalité indépendante, fiable et responsable - Fortes compétences en équipe ainsi que de bonnes compétences en matière d'organisation - Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture, compétences anglaises d'avantage Qu'est-ce que Naturex? - Possibilités de formation et d'éducation continue passionnantes - 20% de réduction sur les chèques REKA - Parking gratuit sur nos sites - Divers prix (Sécurité/Qualité/Sûreté (idea 499)) - Remise dans la boutique des employés - Carte CC Top - Possibilité d'acheter une allocation de vacances - Assurance supplémentaire - VUVA - Participation à l'abonnement demi-taxe - Participation à l'abonnement fitness - Cours de préparation payé pour la retraite Chez Givaudan, vous contribuez à créer de délicieuses expériences de goût et de parfum qui enrichissent la vie des gens. Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui émergent de diverses cultures, origines et expériences. Toute personne – indépendamment de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de son handicap, de sa culture, de sa religion ou de sa situation personnelle – est la bienvenue à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir. Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Rejoignez-nous et construisez un avenir meilleur avec nous.
